paper_title: Stochastic fluctuations of bosonic dark matter
suggested_experiment_name: Stochastic-corrected axion-nucleon DM constraints (Centers et al., CASPEr-ZULF/nEDM reanalysis)
coupling_convention: g_aNN in GeV^-1, exactly as plotted on the y-axis (log10 g_aNN [GeV^-1])
notes: This is a theoretical/statistical reanalysis paper, not a new experimental search. It shows that prior bosonic DM constraints (CASPEr-ZULF, nEDM, dilaton clock/spectroscopy searches) operating in the T << tau_c regime must be relaxed by factors ~3-10 (e.g. x3.0 for scalar Bayesian, x2.7 frequentist, x8.4 for pseudoscalar wind searches) due to the stochastic Rayleigh-distributed field amplitude. The modified exclusion plots (Fig. 3 gaNN in GeV^-1, Fig. 4 dilaton d_e) are rescalings of previously published limits from other papers; no numerical limit values are tabulated or stated in text. The pre-analysis hint of AxionEDM is incorrect: the main plot is the axion-nucleon gradient coupling gaNN, though dilaton (ScalarPhoton/ScalarElectron) couplings are also discussed, making the coupling type ambiguous.
